title: Understanding the Regular Expression
text: The regular expression `**510$` is used to match strings that start and end with '510'. Consider how this might affect the matching of phone numbers that start with '510'.

title: Correct Regular Expression
text: To match phone numbers that start with '510', you need a regular expression that checks the beginning of the string. Think about how you can use `**` to indicate the start of a string and what should follow '510'.
